facts.text: The Free Tuition Promise covers the full cost of tuition for first-time college students who are Texas residents and qualify for the full Pell Grant.

sources.title: Freshman Scholarships - Texas Wesleyan University
sources.quote: That's why we have created the Free Tuition Promise — a program designed to cover the full cost of tuition for first-time college students who are Texas residents and qualify for the full Pell Grant.
